brief:
The Palestinian Industrial Estates and Free Zones Authority organized a media tour of the Bethlehem Industrial Estate, bringing journalists, media representatives and economic program officials to the facility, Palestine News Network reported. The tour was designed to showcase the estate's achievements and demonstrate its resilience amid broader economic conditions in the West Bank.

The visit reflected the authority's push to highlight industrial development progress and draw attention to the Bethlehem facility's operational capacity. Such tours serve as a platform for Palestinian economic institutions to present their work to media outlets and underscore the role of industrial zones in the local economy.
